currency: USD per 1M tokens, global endpoint, standard (non-batch) tier, <=200K input
billing_rules: Gemini text output price covers response and reasoning tokens.
Claude output_tokens include thinking tokens; both are billed at the output rate.
Gemini 3.8/3.7 Flash introductory price applies through 2026-12-31; standard price from 2027-01-01 is $1.50/$7.50.

gpt_oss.note: The existing transport sends reasoning_effort only to Gemini 3; gpt-oss runs at its endpoint default.
